title: Bald Eagles Went From 417 Pairs To 71,000
source: Sources: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service bald eagle population surveys, nesting-pair counts for the lower 48 states (1963 all-time low of 417 pairs; 1982, 1997, 2007, 2009 and 2020 counts per USFWS, American Eagle Foundation and 2021 DOI/USFWS announcement reporting).
